ActivityEvent.description: One durable item from the tenant activity outbox.
ActivityEvent.title: ActivityEvent

ActivityExperiment.description: Current aggregate and children for one experiment.
ActivityExperiment.title: ActivityExperiment

ActivityHierarchy.description:
Authoritative recovery projection for the live ownership hierarchy.

"Snapshot" names the immutable ``TrajectorySnapshot`` resource, so the
activity projection uses "hierarchy" instead.
ActivityHierarchy.title: ActivityHierarchy

ActivityPage.description: A resumable JSON page from an activity feed.
ActivityPage.title: ActivityPage

ActivityScenario.description: Frozen scenario and aggregate state within an experiment.
ActivityScenario.title: ActivityScenario

ActivitySession.description: Current activity projection for one environment session.
ActivitySession.title: ActivitySession

BranchRequest.description:
Strict command that creates one child Session from a Checkpoint.

There is no separate Branch resource: the child Session carries the parent
Session, Checkpoint, lineage, and intervention references.
BranchRequest.title: BranchRequest

Checkpoint.description:
Immutable resumable state for one Session revision.

A Checkpoint exists to resume or branch execution and may reference private
opaque continuation state. It is not an authorized evidence projection; use
`TrajectorySnapshot` for repeatable inspection and export.
Checkpoint.title: Checkpoint

CheckpointPage.description: A cursor-paged index of Checkpoint resources.
CheckpointPage.title: CheckpointPage

exact_agents.description: Require exact participant continuation state for every participant.
exact_agents.title: Exact Agents

ComparisonRequest.description: A typed derived-comparison request. No comparison authority is stored.
ComparisonRequest.title: ComparisonRequest

CredentialRequest.description: Participant credentials are scoped by the route, never by the body.

ttl.description: Credential lifetime in seconds. Values above 86400 are capped at 86400.
ttl.title: Ttl

CredentialRequest.title: CredentialRequest

CredentialRequirement.description: A named credential requirement. Values never appear in portable JSON.
CredentialRequirement.title: CredentialRequirement

token.description: Opaque participant credential. Treat this value as a secret.
token.title: Token

DatasetPage.description: A cursor-paged index of TrajectoryDataset resources.
DatasetPage.title: DatasetPage

EnvironmentReferenceModel.title: EnvironmentReferenceModel

details.message: Input should be a supported command

EvidenceEvent.description: One hash-chained row from a session's append-only evidence journal.
EvidenceEvent.title: EvidenceEvent

EvidencePage.description: A resumable JSON page of session evidence.
EvidencePage.title: EvidencePage

Experiment.description:
A frozen plan spanning an environment, scenarios, participants, and trials.

This is the portable read resource. The local execution builder returned by
``EnvironmentHarness.experiment(...)`` is a different object.
Experiment.title: Experiment

ExperimentPage.description: A cursor-paged index of Experiment resources.
ExperimentPage.title: ExperimentPage

ExperimentPlan.description: The frozen plan. ``EnvironmentSpec`` is embedded, not a separate resource.
ExperimentPlan.title: ExperimentPlan

ExperimentStatus.description: A derived aggregate projection, never an execution authority.
ExperimentStatus.title: ExperimentStatus

ListLinks.description: Relative navigation for one management collection page.
ListLinks.title: ListLinks

MetricDeclaration.description: A declared aggregate metric. Executable scoring code stays installed.
MetricDeclaration.title: MetricDeclaration

OperationSpec.description: Frozen identity and public configuration for environment-supplied work.
OperationSpec.title: OperationSpec

ParticipantBinding.description: One actor in an experiment, bound to a policy or adapter reference.
ParticipantBinding.title: ParticipantBinding

ParticipantContinuation.description: Whether one participant can continue exactly from this Checkpoint.
ParticipantContinuation.title: ParticipantContinuation

Policy.description: Portable identity for an agent policy without serializing live framework state.
Policy.title: Policy

PolicyPage.description: A cursor-paged index of Policy resources.
PolicyPage.title: PolicyPage

RecordTime.description:
Clocks are preserved, never coerced into one scalar.

Ordering comes from the durable record sequence and causal links; a
timestamp alone never establishes causality.
RecordTime.title: RecordTime

ResourceReference.description: Enough identity to avoid mutable-name ambiguity across resources.
ResourceReference.title: ResourceReference

ScenarioReference.description: One immutable scenario selected into a scenario set.
ScenarioReference.title: ScenarioReference

ScenarioSet.description:
An ordered, digest-bound collection of scenarios used as experiment input.

`ScenarioSet` names the *input* collection. `TrajectoryDataset` keeps its own
meaning as a dataset of completed trajectory snapshots; the two are
deliberately different types.
ScenarioSet.title: ScenarioSet

ScenarioSetPage.description: A cursor-paged index of ScenarioSet resources.
ScenarioSetPage.title: ScenarioSetPage

Session.description: One concrete attempt for one scenario and trial within an Experiment.
Session.title: Session

SessionLineage.description: Parent, Checkpoint, and intervention references for a branched child.
SessionLineage.title: SessionLineage

SessionPage.description: A cursor-paged index of Session resources.
SessionPage.title: SessionPage

SessionStatus.description:
Independent status dimensions. None of them implies another.

A finished process, an accepted command, or a completed ingestion batch never
proves task success.
SessionStatus.title: SessionStatus

SnapshotPage.description: A cursor-paged index of TrajectorySnapshot resources.
SnapshotPage.title: SnapshotPage

SourceCollection.description: Collection health for the trajectory's delivery backlog.
SourceCollection.title: SourceCollection

SourcePage.description: A cursor-paged index of SourceStatus resources.
SourcePage.title: SourcePage

TrainingRunPage.description: A cursor-paged index of TrainingRun resources.
TrainingRunPage.title: TrainingRunPage

Trajectory.description: Immutable, portable projection of one native or imported trace.
Trajectory.title: Trajectory

TrajectoryPage.description: A cursor-paged index of TrajectorySummary resources.
TrajectoryPage.title: TrajectoryPage

TrajectorySegment.description:
One addressable execution interval inside a trajectory.

Even a single uninterrupted run receives one segment, so there is never a
second record shape with a missing segment. A pause, process restart,
checkpoint continuation, recovery attempt, or counterfactual branch starts a
new segment instead of pretending the episode was one sequential run.
TrajectorySegment.title: TrajectorySegment

TrajectorySnapshot.description: Immutable export boundary for an authorized trajectory projection.
TrajectorySnapshot.title: TrajectorySnapshot

TrajectoryStatus.description:
The detail projection. Records are a separately paged stream.

``Trajectory.status`` never materializes a record tuple: its digest binds
the typed manifest and the authoritative evidence or source head, and record
pages remain independently verifiable against those boundaries.
TrajectoryStatus.title: TrajectoryStatus

BearerAuth.description: Opaque EnvironmentHarness credential. The server resolves it to an identity and one of its fixed management, viewer, or participant access policies.

post.description:
Create the supported implicit experiment-of-one.

The request carries the structured environment reference for one
server-configured implementation; the server resolves it against its
typed factory dependencies and never loads executable code from a
request. Multi-scenario experiments are created through the trusted
in-process SDK.
